Don't buy these, because it's a gamble on whether you get a good piece or get a defective one. Defects: QC on these is really bad. Problems: Why are the controls so unintuitive? When you wear these neckbands, the volume up button is at the bottom and volume down is at the top, what a wonderful design. Also, because there is the extra weight of the controls on the right side, compared to the left side, any kind of movement of the head rotates the earphones inside your ear, which makes it really unpleasant to have on. I would have given it an even lower rating, but other neckbands on the market are even worse, and there's nothing I can do about that. And don't even get me started on the "voice" of the neckband. It's so annoying, done just to "stand out". Everytime you turn it on, it goes "Power on, you've plugged into Nirvana. You've connected to boat Rockerzz." Also when shutting it down, it goes "Adios amigo, powering off..." So annoying, so much annoying. There is 0 simplicity and subtlety in this product. Also there's no aptX of any kind, and the even AAC is hard to maintain on certain phones, as it will keep resetting back to SBC, so false advertising at its finest. And sound quality? I bought this neckband just to have something to listen music on when I'm trying to focus and keep my phone as far as possible, but it's such a finicky and irritating product. Thanks to Flipkart for super fast delivery. The order was delivered to me in 13-14 hours which is very good! Now coming to the earbuds, The package/box has the following contents on unboxing :- 1. The earpods which is placed inside the case 2. Two pairs of extra ear tips to adjust according to your size and get the perfect fit 3. A USB-C charging cable 4. A boat sticker  5. Few paperwork like warranty card, FAQ, User Manual and others The case looks good and the earbuds are very light, comfortable and fits perfectly in the ears. I have used it continuously for 4-5 hrs at one go it doesn't cause any discomfort or pain to your ears. The earbuds are held in the case via magnets which are decent and strong. The case colour is too glossy and is prone to scratches and fingerprints (would have preferred it to be a bit less glossy as it'll really look scratched in a few days of normal use). The hinge is good no wobbles however it could have been a better better in quality howebe considering the price it's good. The sound if the earbuds is pretty good. Yes it won't beat your wired bassy earphones however it's very good indeed. Sound levels are good. It gives sound like a rupees 500-600 wired earphones. I don't think the sound could have been better at this budget. The mic is okay and acceptable. You won't face any issues while taking calls or attending meetings when you are indoors however outdoors it'll struggle (this is a problem of almost every earbud and is a limitation by design since the earbuds have mic placed far from your mouth unlike neckbands or other earphones where the mic is directly in front of you) There is no disconnection issue, the charging time of the earbuds from the case is around 30-35 mins and it gave me a backup of 4-5 hours at 50-60% sound levels. Overall I'll rate it 4.3* not a perfect 5 as I think the build quality, battery of the case and mic could have been a bit better. If I observe anything else will update the review. product_name: Hp S1000 Ambidextrous Optical Mouse Upto [0955]
review_text: I purchased the **HP S1000 Wireless Mouse (Model: 7YA12PA#ACJ)** on **12 March 2026**, and this has been one of the most disappointing HP products I have ever used. I use the mouse only for **normal office work (around 8 hours a day)**. The biggest problem is its **extremely poor battery life**. A brand-new AA alkaline battery lasts only **10–15 days**. In the **last 25 days alone, I have already replaced two new branded batteries**, and both were completely drained. To make sure it wasn't a defective unit, **I got the mouse replaced through an HP Service Center. Unfortunately, the replacement unit has exactly the same issue. Even after replacement, the battery drain problem remains unchanged.** This means the problem is not limited to a single piece. Either the product has a serious design flaw or its power management is very poor. A wireless mouse from a reputed brand like HP should normally last for several months on a single battery under regular office use. Apart from the unnecessary battery expense, it is also very frustrating because the mouse suddenly stops working when the battery gets exhausted. Having to keep spare batteries all the time defeats the purpose of buying a wireless mouse. Over time, the cost of replacing batteries becomes much higher than expected. I wasted my time visiting the HP Service Center, expecting the replacement would solve the problem. Unfortunately, the replacement behaves exactly the same, which has completely destroyed my confidence in this product. **Pros:** * Comfortable to hold. * Cursor performance is decent. **Cons:** * Extremely poor battery backup (only 10–15 days). * Replacement from HP Service Center did not fix the issue. * High recurring battery cost. * Unreliable for daily office work. * Poor power management. * Not worth the money. I expected much better quality from HP. Based on my personal experience, I cannot recommend this mouse to anyone. Save your money and consider another brand instead
